newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $295 mln for Thursday, March 13.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $295 mln for Thursday, March 13.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday, March 13 are expected to total $295 million in 22 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $186 million in seven sales, with a $115 million Harris County, Texas deal through Merrill Lynch topping the list.
On the competitive side, 15 sales totaling $109 million are on the schedule, a $30 million Jersey City deal is the largest at 1100 EST.
An additional two sales totaling $48 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Thursday, depending on market conditions.
